hierarchy: worker > worker_rig (Armature, 21 bones) > worker_body (SkinnedMesh, rigid 1-bone weights)

rig.skinning: every vertex weighted 1.0 to one bone (rigid toy segments) -> cheap, no candy-wrapping
rig.Walk: 1.0 s loop (31 frames @30fps), in place; drive root at ~1.35 m/s (stride 0.67 m, 2 steps/cycle) to avoid foot slide
rig.Idle: 2.0 s loop (61 frames @30fps): breathing, head look, arm sway
